messages:
Ana (CS): Heads up — we have 5 high-touch onboarding accounts hit by last night's reindex failures. Need a tailored RCA + outreach playbook.
Leo (PM): Agreed. Can we split outreach by onboarding stage? early trial vs mid-setup vs post-setup.
Sam (Eng): Quick update from infra: root cause is a memory leak in the vpc-reindex connector exacerbated by long-running batch jobs. Patch built, running canary now.
Oncall Bot: Canary deploy initiated: hotfix/vpc-reindex-memfix (#4321). Canary started at 2142001400 UTC.
Maria (CS Lead): Proposal: 1) Live call + personalized RCA doc for high-touch accounts; 2) concise email + FAQ for impacted self-serve; 3) reindex voucher for onboarding continuity.
Ana (CS): Drafting call script and short RCA. Sam, can you give me a customer-friendly one-paragraph technical summary I can read on calls?
Sam (Eng): Sure — draft below (feel free to copy):
"Short tech summary: a memory leak in a third-party connector caused intermittent 503s during large reindex jobs. This led to failed or stalled indexing for some onboarding imports. We implemented a patch that prevents the leak and added retries and circuit breakers to avoid recurrence. Full verification is underway; manual reindexes are available while we confirm stability."
Leo (PM): Add expected timeline and mitigation steps to the script: ETA for full verification 03:00 UTC, manual reindex instructions, and the voucher offer.
Ana (CS): Voucher suggestion? Fixed amount or case-by-case?
Maria (CS Lead): For speed, propose a standard offer to start: one free full reindex + 25% onboarding credit backdated to the impacted batch. We can escalate exceptions to Customer Escalations.
Sam (Eng): Canary looks good so far — zero errors in canary window (logs attached to incident ticket). I'll post final all-clear when rollout completes.
Oncall Bot: Hotfix rollout: 2142001700 -> 2142002000. Status: healthy.
Ana (CS): I'll schedule calls for the 5 accounts now and send the email template to the wider list. Will include: one-paragraph tech summary, what we did, what we're doing, manual reindex link, voucher terms, and contact for follow-ups.
Leo (PM): Please include an explicit ask for feedback about onboarding friction — capture one-line consent to a short follow-up survey.
Maria (CS Lead): I'll review the drafts in 10m. Ana, tag me when ready and I'll prioritize the high-touch calls.
Ana (CS): Drafts done and uploaded to #cs-docs. Scheduling invites sent for the high-touch calls.
Sam (Eng): Final: rollout completed at 2142002350, post-deploy logs clean. Incident ticket: INC-2021-vpc-reindex. I'll share the postmortem once it's triaged.
Ana (CS): Great — we'll reference INC-2021 in customer comms and follow up with a tailored RCA doc after postmortem. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
